en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4525 - Al-Alaa ibn Razin narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) that the Messenger of Allah (swt) said:
"Archangel Jibril (as) advised me regarding women so much that I thought divorce should not be permissible except in the case of clear indecency."
